info.title: AIOManager API
info.description: Hybrid sync server for AIOManager. Served same-origin under /api/*.

post.summary: Store or update a provider API key

provider.description: Provider id or known alias (tmdb, tvdb, mdblist, simkl, pmdb)

get.summary: List configured providers without exposing raw keys
Decrypt and return the raw provider key

post.summary: Import provider keys from an AIOMetadata instance

get.summary: Test a stored (or unsaved) provider API key

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Unsaved key value to test instead of the stored one

source.description: Where the tested key came from (user, unsaved) or null

post.summary: Every install and acknowledged delete for the requested addon url keys

accountId.description: Account id the actions belong to

urlKeys.description: Normalized addon URL keys (tombstone key space), up to 200 per request; over-long keys are skipped

actions.description: Every row for the requested keys, newest activity first, no cap

urlKey.description: The requested normalized addon URL key (tombstone key space)

transportUrl.description: Transport URL of the latest install

lastInstallAt.description: Server Unix epoch (ms) of the latest install

lastDeleteAt.description: Server Unix epoch (ms) of the latest delete

installSeq.description: Row sequence of the latest install; compared against deleteSeq for eligibility

deleteSeq.description: Row sequence of the latest delete; compared against installSeq for eligibility

deleteToken.description: Client deletion identity the delete acknowledged

post.summary: Acknowledge client addon deletions on the server
Enqueue a bulk account command (protect-all, unprotect-all)

id.description: Command id (matches the client bulk-action registry)

accountIds.description: Account ids the command should run against

get.summary: Poll a command job status and per-account results
